import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
dtp_idx = df[df[0].str.contains('DTP/DT/DTaP', na=False)].index[0]
# Look for Below poverty and At or above poverty under DTP section
sub = df.iloc[dtp_idx:dtp_idx+20]
below = float(sub[sub[0].str.strip() == 'Below poverty'].iloc[0, 7])
above = float(sub[sub[0].str.strip() == 'At or above poverty'].iloc[0, 7])
result = round(above - below, 2)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)

result = str(min_year)

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nchs_hus_child_vaccination.xlsx', sheet_name='A', header=None)
polio_idx = df[df[0].str.contains('Polio \(3 doses or more\)', na=False)].index[0]
# Race/ethnicity groups under Polio: rows after 'Not Hispanic or Latino' up to Hispanic or Latino
# Rows 55 to 62: White only, Black or African American only, American Indian or Alaska Native only, Asian only, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander only, 2 or more races, Hispanic or Latino\2
groups = []
for r in range(polio_idx + 3, polio_idx + 10):
    name = str(df.iloc[r, 0]).split('\\')[0].strip()
    val = df.iloc[r, 7]
    if val != '*' and pd.notna(val):
        groups.append((df.iloc[r, 0], float(val)))

groups.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
result = [groups[0][0], groups[1][0]]
